name: Sticker Displace
summary: Stickers that warp the background behind them with a living SVG turbulence + displacement filter through backdrop-filter. The noise flows, swells on hover, and a slider panel tunes every parameter and rewrites the markup.
support: Chromium, Firefox 103+. Safari ignores url() in backdrop-filter → no warp, sticker still fine.

name: Expanding Rows
summary: Full-width service rows that open to reveal tag pills and a description. The + rotates into ×, pills stagger in, heights animate with grid-template-rows.

name: Circle Text
summary: Text on a circle that spins, drinks scroll velocity and eases back. Centre slot for an arrow, logo or portrait.

name: Stacked Footer
summary: A huge CTA word that replicates upward as the footer scrolls in: clipped slices rise from behind a sticky link. Pure CSS.

name: Grain Field
summary: An animated film-grain layer that boils over any section. One oversized tile of canvas-generated noise, jumped to a random offset every frame.
support: All modern browsers. mix-blend-mode overlay needs a non-transparent backdrop.

name: Beacon Hero
summary: A blueprint-grid hero: hairline columns rule themselves in, the headline resolves character by character, and a centre mark deploys satellite nodes along dotted connectors.

name: Orbit Stack
summary: An integrations diagram: logo chips on concentric rings that drift at their own speed, wired to a centre mark with dotted connectors. Hover isolates one path.

name: FAQ Rail
summary: A notched folder-tab rail beside an accordion. The section pins itself and each screenful of scroll steps to the next category, so the FAQ keeps going instead of ending.

name: Unfold Hero
summary: A dashboard held in 3D perspective with UI cards scattered around it, flattening and snapping into place as you scroll. One progress value drives plate, cards and shadow.
